buildCommand: pnpm --filter @workspace/smart-borrowing build && rm -rf public && mkdir -p public && if [ -d artifacts/smart-borrowing/dist/public ]; then cp -R artifacts/smart-borrowing/dist/public/. public/; elif [ -d dist/public ]; then cp -R dist/public/. public/; else echo 'Build output not found'; find . -maxdepth 5 -type d -name public -print; exit 1; fi
